source: Current owner message: CODEX — Adopt RAW CLOSE ONLY Policy for CaféF Market History
statement: Use only daily unadjusted closing prices (GiaDongCua) from CaféF. Do not use CaféF adjusted prices (GiaDieuChinh) in investment calculations, valuation, scoring, portfolio analytics, historical returns or backtesting. Preserve raw source responses including adjusted fields for audit. Missing raw close must not fall back to adjusted close. Historical returns/backtests require raw close plus separately verified dividends and corporate actions; incomplete action evidence returns NOT_QUALIFIED.
